svg.title: Ajourné Interval Palette: original complete color-coded quick chart, unison through octave
svg.desc: Thirteen labeled interval cards with their names, musical spellings, exact semitone numbers zero to twelve, illustrative color swatches, listening descriptors and uses. All example pairs begin on C4. Colors are personal artistic suggestions, not intrinsic acoustic facts.
svg.text: AJOURNÉ INTO MUSIC / AN ORIGINAL REFERENCE
Twelve semitone steps. Thirteen landmarks. A world of musical choices.
One-octave chart: every example holds C4 as its starting note. Read the pitch facts, then choose your own colors.
The sounds have precise distances. The colors are invitations.
Together and sequentially can sound different. Register, timbre, harmony and culture matter.
Ajourné into Music • Print or paint this chart • The full Interval Atlas explores each sound in depth.
